Record notes

Eight complete survey workflows with schemas, exporters and synthetic instruments.

Version 0.1.1 includes 8 complete skill procedures. Complete original methods and helpers; restricted supplied question-type archive excluded.

Requirements: Host file tools; Python for validation and export helpers.

License scope: MIT. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add survey-studio@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP has its portable manifest at the root, preserves all referenced package files and includes a per-file hash inventory. Built from 65519bccb27654c9cc9bfd1878ed0084b48316a9. SHA-256: 0d67fd42574d18d933019148f7fa76a408b9984e25153124160826ad114bdd97.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
